content.title: Commercial execution — Virelza
content.subtitle: First-line maintenance therapy for biomarker-selected ovarian cancer
bulletPoints: 1,420 patients on therapy at quarter-end, up 39% YoY; median treatment duration increased to 8.7 months from 7.9 months
Community accounts generated one-third of sales for the first time after 74 priority practices completed pathway review
New patient starts rose 18% sequentially despite two fewer selling days and normalized year-end inventory
Payer coverage reached 93% of U.S. commercial lives; average prior-authorization turnaround improved from 3.8 to 2.6 days
Field force remains at 112 representatives; territories in Florida, Texas, and the Mid-Atlantic carry the largest unpenetrated pools
European partner Novera submitted the EMA variation in April 2026; a CHMP opinion is expected in Q1 2027

content.title: FY2026 outlook and catalysts
content.subtitle: Guidance as of May 7, 2026; excludes potential business-development transactions
bulletPoints: Virelza net product sales maintained at $360M-$380M, implying 34%-41% growth over FY2025
GAAP operating expense maintained at $420M-$445M, including approximately $48M of non-cash stock compensation
Year-end cash and investments expected at $430M-$455M; current resources support operations into Q4 2027
September 2026 — FDA Type C meeting for AT-318 Phase 3 design and companion-diagnostic plan
Q4 2026 — AT-201 pivotal cohort topline response and duration-of-response data
Q1 2027 — expected CHMP opinion for Virelza label expansion and manufacturing comparability submission
